notes: Receive in each, packs, cartons or pallets (10 cartons books 10 × the SKU's carton size), on the desk, on an ASN line and in the receiving CSV, and see stock in its units everywhere (1 pallet · 1 carton · 3 each). Move many things at once: scan a location, untick what stays, scan where it goes; or fill in a move sheet and upload it, previewed first and all or nothing. The ledger has a search box under every column that takes several values at once, and each SKU's Inventory tab shows its full movement history with the on-hand total after every movement. Also includes 1.31.0: location rules (pick priority, one SKU or mixed, hard size and weight limits) with CSV import and export, SKU size and weight per level, a Receive button on every ASN line, and batch pick numbers.
